name: lms-oidc-provider-disabled
description: Count LMS login failures caused by a missing/disabled OIDC provider config ("disabled backend/provider").
filter: resource.type="k8s_container" AND resource.labels.namespace_name="mereka-lms" AND resource.labels.container_name="lms" AND (textPayload=~"disabled backend/provider" OR textPayload=~"OAuth2ProviderConfig" OR textPayload=~"Can't fetch setting of a disabled backend/provider")
